description: Change a video made here: make another take, cut it, join videos, or lay a voice or song over it.

offer.reason: adult on their own written screen with video on; this chat already holds a finished video (a cut, a join or a voice or song over it needs only the video editor on this computer)

author: MaiPai

examples: try that again with a slow camera move
add some music to the video

clip.description: Which video: "latest" for the newest one in this chat, or a video id. Use latest unless the person names another. For join, the videos go in clips.

change.description: another_take makes the same video again with a new random result. remix makes it again with the changes the person asked for: set only the fields they changed. make_it_max makes the same video at the Max level; it is for people an admin allowed and the tool says so if not, and you tell the person in your own words. trim cuts the video: set from_s and to_s (seconds). join puts the person's own videos in order into one: set clips. mix lays a spoken line or one of the person's songs over the video: set sound, and line or track. Cutting, joining and mixing make a new video from the finished one; the old one is kept. A video exists only if you called this tool in this reply: never say one is being made without calling it.

prompt.description: For remix only: the new full description of the video, when the person changed what it shows. A line a person says goes in quotes, one person speaking at a time. Cartoon characters should be named and described with their era and animation style.

look.description: For remix only: a new look, when the person asks for one.

camera.description: For remix only: a new camera move or style, when the person asks for one.

voices.description: For remix only: clean means no laugh track and no music; full adds music and sound effects. Use full only when the person asks for music or effects.

tier.description: For remix only: a new level, when the person asks for more or less quality. Max is for people an admin allowed.

seconds.description: For remix only: a new length in seconds, 1 to 10. A length a level cannot make is cut to fit, and the tool says so.

keep_seed.description: For remix only: true when the person wants the same result with the change, as close to the first as possible. Leave it out otherwise.

from_s.description: For trim only: where the kept part starts, in seconds from the start of the video. Leave it out to keep from the start.

to_s.description: For trim only: where the kept part ends, in seconds from the start. "Cut the first two seconds" is from_s 2 with to_s left out; "keep the first four seconds" is to_s 4.

clips.description: For join only: 2 to 6 of the person's own videos in the order they want them, each a video id or "latest". Only videos made by this person.

sound.description: For mix only: voice lays a spoken line over the video (set line); music lays one of the person's own songs or sound files (set track).

line.description: For mix with voice: the exact words to say, as the person typed or dictated them. A line of about 12 words fits 5 seconds.

voice.description: For mix with voice: the name of one of this home's voices when the person names one. Leave it out to use the person's own voice.

track.description: For mix with music: the id of the person's own song (a music job) or sound file in their Library.

level.description: For mix only: how loud the new sound is against the video's own sound, from quiet to very_loud. Leave it out for the default: a voice over a lowered video sound, a song softly under it.

start_s.description: For mix only: seconds into the video where the new sound starts. Leave it out to start at the beginning.
